query: SELECT c.id, c.devedorId, c.nossoNumero, c.status, c.statusRemessa, c.amount, c.dueDate, d.name FROM cobrancas c JOIN devedores d ON c.devedorId = d.id WHERE d.name LIKE '%Antonio%' OR d.name LIKE '%Carlos%' ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 10;
